title: Delete Tree Nodes
summary: Given a tree with nodes rooted at 0, where each node has a value and a parent, remove all subtrees with a sum of node values equal to zero.
statement: Given a tree with nodes rooted at 0, where each node has a value and a parent, remove all subtrees with a sum of node values equal to zero. Return the count of remaining nodes.
constraints: parent describes a rooted tree with root zero and parent[0] equal to -1.
Delete every subtree whose node-value sum is zero, including all its descendants.
Return the number of nodes remaining.
hints: Build child lists from the parent array.
Postorder returns each subtree’s sum and surviving node count.
If the completed sum is zero, return zero surviving nodes to the parent.
Every descendant is included before the deletion decision, so a deleted root removes its entire subtree.
editorial: Every descendant is included before the deletion decision, so a deleted root removes its entire subtree.

tests.explanation: The zero-sum subtree rooted at node two removes four nodes, leaving three.
No complete subtree sums to zero, so all seven remain.
